title: Virtual simulation configuration
statement: Given a finite Boolean Turing machine $M$, Boolean lists $x,y$, a configuration $c$ of $M$ on input $y$, a Boolean tag, a valid input-head position $p$ for $x$, and Boolean lists $a$ and $pre$, this defines a configuration for the mapping machine on input $x$. Its state is the state of $c$ wrapped as a running state with the given tag, its input-head position is $p$, its work tapes contain the buffer for $a$, the list $y$, and then the work tapes of $c$, and its output is $pre$ followed by the output of $c$. The work-head positions are $|a|$, the input-head position of $c$ minus one, and then the work-head positions of $c$.
